home.badge: Private · Membership-based · B2B trading ecosystem · Cameroon
home.subhead: Corgania is a private, membership-based B2B trading ecosystem connecting verified African manufacturers, producers, exporters and wholesalers with qualified international bulk buyers — from quotation to delivery.
home.ecosystemTitle: Four divisions. One trusted trading ecosystem.
home.ecosystemIntro: Corgania solves the three problems that hold African trade back: market access, trust, and fragmented execution.
home.divInsightsText: Corporate intelligence on African markets, commodities and trade — published with sources, units and dates, never invented figures.
home.divMarketplaceText: A private, members-only wholesale marketplace where approved African sellers and international buyers discover, negotiate and trade.
home.divVerifyText: Registration checks, document review and physical inspection before any business is approved to trade. Approval is earned, never automatic.
home.divTradeText: Structured transaction management: documentation, inspection coordination and shipment milestones from order to delivery.
home.sellersText: Reach qualified international bulk buyers through your own branded storefront. Complete verification once, then list products, respond to RFQs and build export relationships that compound.
home.buyersText: Source directly from businesses whose registration, documents and premises have been assessed. Search verified suppliers, issue structured RFQs and compare quotations in one place.
home.insightsText: Every dataset Corgania publishes carries its source, unit, currency, period and last-updated date. Until a licensed data source is connected, we show you exactly that — instead of invented prices.
home.pricesUnavailable: Live benchmark prices are not yet available.
home.step1Text: Businesses register, submit documentation and complete Corgania Verify — including inspection where required.
home.step2Text: Independent review and approval decisions. Registration alone never grants marketplace access.
home.step3Text: Source products, issue RFQs, compare quotations and negotiate directly with verified counterparties.
home.step4Text: Orders move through documented milestones — preparation, inspection, shipment and delivery.
home.trustProcess: Trust is a process, not a badge.
home.trustText: Verification scope and status are disclosed on every supplier profile, and a suspended member's products immediately stop being tradeable.
home.emptyInsightsText: Corgania Insights articles are published from our CMS by the editorial team. No placeholder stories are displayed.
home.finalTitle: Join the ecosystem African trade deserves.
home.finalText: Applications are reviewed by Corgania Verify. Membership is approved — never sold as instant access.

about.title: About Corgania
about.hero: Built for the businesses that feed, build and supply the world.
about.lead: Corgania is a private, membership-based B2B trading ecosystem connecting verified African manufacturers, producers, exporters and wholesalers with qualified international bulk buyers.
about.p1: Legitimate African businesses lose international contracts for three reasons: buyers cannot find them, buyers cannot trust what they find, and every transaction is assembled from scratch across fragmented channels. Corgania exists to remove all three barriers inside one integrated ecosystem.
about.whereText: Corgania begins with Cameroonian businesses and expands across Africa in phases, as regional verification capacity is established. Our buyers source from Europe, North America, Asia and other global markets.
about.howText: Corgania Insights publishes sourced market intelligence. Corgania Verify assesses registration, documentation and premises before membership is approved. Corgania Marketplace is open only to approved members. Corgania Trade Services manages the documented execution of transactions.
about.wontText: We do not sell instant marketplace access, publish invented market statistics, or present unverified businesses as verified. Verification scope is disclosed on every profile, and approval is a decision — never a payment receipt.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.hero: From application to delivered shipment — with verification at every gate.
howItWorks.lead: Corgania is not an open directory. Every organisation that trades has completed Corgania Verify, and every order moves through documented milestones.

membership.title: Membership
membership.lead: Registration starts onboarding. Marketplace trading requires an approved organisation after Corgania Verify.
membership.sellersLead: Join as a producer, manufacturer, exporter or wholesaler and sell to qualified international bulk buyers.
membership.sellersWhat: A branded storefront with your catalogue, bulk pricing tiers and certifications; access to buyer RFQs matched to your categories; direct messaging with buyers; and Trade Services support for documentation, inspection and shipment milestones.
membership.sellersVerify: Registered business name and country, registration details, legal address, authorised representative, business activities, relevant licences and supporting documents. Physical inspection may be required. Document upload or fee payment alone never approves an application — an independent approver makes the final decision.
membership.buyersLead: Every supplier on Corgania has passed registration, document and — where required — premises verification.
membership.buyersWhat: Search verified suppliers by country, industry and minimum order quantity; issue structured RFQs to eligible sellers; compare quotations side by side; negotiate in-platform; and manage orders through documented milestones to delivery.
membership.buyersVerify: Buyers complete a risk-appropriate checklist confirming company registration, authorised representatives and sourcing intent. Supplier profiles always disclose the scope and status of their assessment, so you know exactly what has — and has not — been checked.
membership.sellersCard: Producers, manufacturers, exporters and wholesalers: branded storefront, product catalogue, RFQ access and Trade Services support.
membership.buyersCard: Bulk buyers and procurement teams: verified supplier search, structured RFQs, quotation comparison and documented order execution.
membership.pricingLead: Seller, buyer, or both — USD 599 per organisation per year after Corgania Verify approval. Founding Members receive six months free.
membership.foundersBody: For organisations approved during our founding window (through 25 Oct 2027). Full marketplace access after Verify. Then converts to Standard Annual.
membership.standardBody: Same access for sellers, buyers, or both. One fee per organisation — not per user. Registration alone never grants trading access.
membership.noteVerify: Membership is approved through Corgania Verify. Payment does not replace verification.

markets.title: African Markets
markets.lead: Country profiles are published only when locally verified supply and sourcing data exists for that market. We would rather show one real market than twenty invented ones.
markets.moreMarkets: Additional African supply markets are announced here as verification operations open in each country.
markets.cameroonBody: Cameroon is Corgania's launch market: the first country where seller verification, inspection operations and marketplace onboarding are active. Approved Cameroonian producers, manufacturers, exporters and wholesalers trade with qualified international buyers through verified storefronts.

tradeOpportunities.title: Trade Opportunities
tradeOpportunities.hero: Buyer demand meets verified African supply.
tradeOpportunities.lead: Open sourcing requests are visible in full only to approved members, so suppliers negotiate with qualified counterparties — not the open internet.
tradeOpportunities.body: International buyers publish structured Requests for Quotation specifying product, specification, quantity, destination, delivery window and quotation deadline. Eligible verified suppliers respond with priced quotations; buyers compare, negotiate and accept — and only an accepted quotation becomes an order.
